setupDoneBody: Novera e tla sepetša dika tša selegae ka llama.cpp.
dsparkDescription: E taonelouta molekane wa DSpark Q8_0 ({{size}}) bakeng sa LFM2.5-2.6B. E ka akgofiša moloko, eupša e šomiša RAM ya tlaleletšo goba VRAM, e tlogela memori ye nnyane bakeng sa seemo. E leke go didirišwa tša gago tša go šoma ka thata; beakanya bolelele bja seemo goba o šitiše go hlatholla ga go fopholetšwa ka dipeakanyong tša mohlala.
